source_PRE.diff:
diff --git a/src/Files.App/Files.App.csproj b/src/Files.App/Files.App.csproj
index ffe246f1c..b0aa229e4 100644
--- a/src/Files.App/Files.App.csproj
+++ b/src/Files.App/Files.App.csproj
@@ -172,4 +172,36 @@
                  Targets="Build"
                  Properties="Configuration=$(Configuration);Platform=$(Platform)" />
     </Target>
+
+    <!-- F9b local pilot only: consume verified frozen binaries, never compile L1 sources. -->
+    <PropertyGroup>
+        <FmL1PackDir>$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\..\..\reference\</FmL1PackDir>
+        <EventSourceSupport>true</EventSourceSupport>
+    </PropertyGroup>
+    <ItemGroup>
+        <Reference Include="FluidMotion.L1" HintPath="$(FmL1PackDir)FluidMotion.L1.dll" Private="true" />
+        <None Include="$(FmL1PackDir)fluidmotion.dll" Link="fluidmotion.dll" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />
+        <None Include="$(FmL1PackDir)demo_motion.json" Link="demo_motion.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />
+        <_FmPilotInput Include="$(FmL1PackDir)FluidMotion.L1.dll" ExpectedHash="94d6489d9bec289732ea3e4a8540b052e576a7182bae3f3367a3e72f04e10dc2" />
+        <_FmPilotInput Include="$(FmL1PackDir)fluidmotion.dll" ExpectedHash="add4857dead413f8211941381c6aa8f73c546f3ecae1774aced79c464719577d" />
+        <_FmPilotInput Include="$(FmL1PackDir)demo_motion.json" ExpectedHash="8d5db5775acad5db0c04cbc3c2a214bb7309670c304b71ff40860757973c410e" />
+    </ItemGroup>
+    <Target Name="VerifyF9bPackBeforeUse" BeforeTargets="ResolveAssemblyReferences">
+        <Error Condition="!Exists('%(_FmPilotInput.Identity)')" Text="F9b frozen reference missing: %(_FmPilotInput.Filename)" />
+        <GetFileHash Files="@(_FmPilotInput)" Algorithm="SHA256">
+            <Output TaskParameter="Items" ItemName="_FmPilotInputHashes" />
+        </GetFileHash>
+        <Error Condition="'%(_FmPilotInputHashes.FileHash)' != '%(_FmPilotInputHashes.ExpectedHash)'" Text="F9b frozen reference hash mismatch: %(_FmPilotInputHashes.Filename)" />
+    </Target>
+    <Target Name="VerifyF9bPackOutput" AfterTargets="CopyFilesToOutputDirectory">
+        <ItemGroup>
+            <_FmPilotOutput Include="$(TargetDir)FluidMotion.L1.dll" ExpectedHash="94d6489d9bec289732ea3e4a8540b052e576a7182bae3f3367a3e72f04e10dc2" />
+            <_FmPilotOutput Include="$(TargetDir)fluidmotion.dll" ExpectedHash="add4857dead413f8211941381c6aa8f73c546f3ecae1774aced79c464719577d" />
+            <_FmPilotOutput Include="$(TargetDir)demo_motion.json" ExpectedHash="8d5db5775acad5db0c04cbc3c2a214bb7309670c304b71ff40860757973c410e" />
+        </ItemGroup>
+        <GetFileHash Files="@(_FmPilotOutput)" Algorithm="SHA256">
+            <Output TaskParameter="Items" ItemName="_FmPilotOutputHashes" />
+        </GetFileHash>
+        <Error Condition="'%(_FmPilotOutputHashes.FileHash)' != '%(_FmPilotOutputHashes.ExpectedHash)'" Text="F9b output reference hash mismatch: %(_FmPilotOutputHashes.Filename)" />
+    </Target>
 </Project>
diff --git a/src/Files.App/Views/MainPage.xaml.cs b/src/Files.App/Views/MainPage.xaml.cs
index 3577f29d9..a3ce43d30 100644
--- a/src/Files.App/Views/MainPage.xaml.cs
+++ b/src/Files.App/Views/MainPage.xaml.cs
@@ -37,6 +37,8 @@ namespace Files.App.Views
 
 		private bool keyReleased = true;
 
+		private FilesMotionPilot? _filesMotionPilot; // F9b local sidefork only.
+
 		private DispatcherQueueTimer _updateDateDisplayTimer;
 		private WindowMessageMonitor? _titleBarMessageMonitor;
 
@@ -47,6 +49,7 @@ namespace Files.App.Views
 		public MainPage()
 		{
 			InitializeComponent();
+			Unloaded += (_, _) => { _filesMotionPilot?.Dispose(); _filesMotionPilot = null; };
 
 			// Dependency Injection
 			UserSettingsService = Ioc.Default.GetRequiredService<IUserSettingsService>();
@@ -332,6 +335,7 @@ namespace Files.App.Views
 
 		private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
 		{
+			_filesMotionPilot ??= new FilesMotionPilot(SettingsButton, MainWindow.Instance);
 			ViewModel.OnPageLoaded();
 
 			MainWindow.Instance.AppWindow.Changed += (_, _) => MainWindow.Instance.RaiseSetTitleBarDragRegion(SetTitleBarDragRegion);
